meta.title: The bid index is restricted to super admins and Procol employees
gaps: the case needs a caller who is not a super admin (or lacks a permission), and every run acts as the client's own super-admin buyer — a refusal it expects may legitimately not happen
The separate missing-vendor_ids request and its expected HTTP 422/code 5 result are not independently represented because only one decisive act is permitted.

words.preconditions: A buyer signed in to the client under test (no event is built).
steps: The buyer sends the bid call, the request the case itself writes.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You are not allowed to perform this action”, and never with a server error.
